# BJP Tamil Nadu Local Body Candidate Application Portal 2026

> Official candidate application portal for BJP local body elections in Tamil Nadu.

## System Overview
This web application enables BJP party candidates across Tamil Nadu to apply for Local Body elections across 12 structured steps.

## Key Features & Endpoints
- Candidate Registration: /candidate-registration
- Admin Portal: /admin
- Verification: Mobile OTP & EPIC Voter ID Verification

## Technical Stack
- React 18, Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Cloudinary
